synopsis.text:
The Flintstones and the Rubbles were enjoying a fine day when suddenly, someone from the future called Dr. Butler arrived and stole their pets, Dino and Hoppy!  Butler plans to feature the pets in his intergalactic zoo, and what's worse, he's destroyed the Great Gazoo's time machine so that no-one could stop him!  It's up to everyone's favourite caveman, Fred Flintstone, to find the pieces to the time machine and repair it, so that they can travel to the future and confront Dr. Butler once and for all!

The Flintstones: The Rescue of Dino & Hoppy is a side-scrolling platformer for the NES.  In it, you control Fred Flintstone through various locations such as Bedrock, Reef Rock, the Jungle and more as he searches for the missing pieces of Gazoo's time machine.  Fred has his trusty club which he can use to attack with, or charge up it's power by holding B for a more deadly attack.  Fred can collect coins after defeating enemies, which are used to pay for secondary weapons like slingshots and tomahawks, as well as special abilities such as flying and diving.

After completing the first level, the player is presented with an overworld map that allows you to choose which level you'd like to go to.  There are also basketball courts on the map - if you beat your opponent in a game of basketball, you can earn one of the special abilities which are required for use later.

Quel remue-ménage dans la préhistoire lorsque les Pierrafeu, la plus illustre famille des cavernes, reçoivent une visite venue tout droit du XXXème siècle. Le Docteur Butler, ingénieux savant, a besoin de quelques dinosaures pour le zoo de la ville de l'Orbite; aussi a t'il inventé une machine à remonter le temps pour capturer Dino et Hoppy. Fred parviendra t'il à réunir toutes les pièces dont a besoin le grand Gazoo pour construire, lui aussi, une machine à remonter le temps? Réussira-t'il, avec l'aide de Wilma, Barney et Betty, à faire un saut dans le futur et à libérer ses amis préhistoriques?
Qui a osé prétendre que l'histoire était un sujet ennuyeux!?

Die Feuersteins und die Geröllheimer genossen einen schönen Tag, als plötzlich jemand aus der Zukunft namens Dr. Butler auftauchte und ihre Haustiere Dino und Hoppy stahl! Butler plant, die Tiere in seinem intergalaktischen Zoo auszustellen, und was noch schlimmer ist, er hat die Zeitmaschine des Großen Gazoo zerstört, damit ihn niemand aufhalten kann! Es liegt an Fred Feuerstein, dem Lieblingshöhlenmenschen aller, die Teile der Zeitmaschine zu finden und sie zu reparieren, damit sie in die Zukunft reisen und Dr. Butler ein für alle Mal zur Rede stellen können!

Los Picapiedra y los Mármol estaban disfrutando de un buen día cuando de repente, alguien del futuro llamado Dr. Butler llegó y robó a sus mascotas, Dino y de Hoppy! El Dr. Butler planea ofrecer a las mascotas en su zoológico intergaláctico, y lo que es peor, ha destruido la máquina del tiempo para que nadie pudiera detenerlo! Todo depende de hombre de las cavernas favorito de todos, Pedro Picapiedra, para encontrar las piezas de la máquina del tiempo y repararla, para que puedan viajar al futuro y enfrentarse al Dr. Butler, una vez por todas!

Che emozione nella preistoria quando i Flintstones, la più illustre famiglia delle caverne, ricevono una visita fin dal 30° secolo. Il dottor Butler, un ingegnoso scienziato, ha bisogno di alcuni dinosauri per lo zoo nella città di Orbit; così ha inventato una macchina del tempo per catturare Dino e Hoppy. Riuscirà Fred a raccogliere tutti i pezzi di cui ha bisogno anche il grande Gazoo per costruire una macchina del tempo? Riuscirà, con l'aiuto di Wilma, Barney e Betty, a saltare nel futuro e a liberare i suoi amici preistorici? Chi ha osato affermare che la storia fosse un argomento noioso!?

Os Flintstones e os Rubbles estavam aproveitando um belo dia quando, de repente, alguém do futuro chamado Dr. Butler chegou e roubou seus animais de estimação, Dino e Hoppy! Butler planeja apresentar os animais de estimação em seu zoológico intergaláctico e, o que é pior, ele destruiu a máquina do tempo do Grande Gazoo para que ninguém pudesse detê-lo! Cabe ao homem das cavernas favorito de todos, Fred Flintstone, encontrar as peças da máquina do tempo e consertá-la, para que possam viajar para o futuro e enfrentar o Dr. Butler de uma vez por todas!
